description: This file defines the GatewayConfig interface, which extends ServiceSpecificConfig and WithProtocolConfig. It provides method signatures for accessing various configuration settings related to the Gateway service, such as HTTP settings, caching, streaming, health checks, commands, messaging, authentication, and public health endpoints.

classes.name: GatewayConfig
classes.description: This interface provides various configuration accessors for the Gateway service, including HTTP, caches, streaming, health checks, commands, messaging, authentication, and public health configurations.

methods.name: getHttpConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration settings related to HTTP for the Gateway service.

methods.name: getCachesConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration settings pertaining to caches used by the Gateway service.

methods.name: getStreamingConfig
methods.description: Returns the streaming configuration, including web socket settings, for the Gateway.

methods.name: getHealthCheckConfig
methods.description: Provides the health check configuration for the Gateway service.

methods.name: getCommandConfig
methods.description: Provides configuration for commands handled by the Gateway; available since version 1.1.0.

methods.name: getMessageConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration for the '/messages' resource of the gateway.

methods.name: getClaimMessageConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration for the '/inbox/claim' resource.

methods.name: getAuthenticationConfig
methods.description: Provides the authentication configuration for the Gateway service.

methods.name: getPublicHealthConfig
methods.description: Provides the configuration for the public health endpoint of the Gateway.
